deprecated_yaml.description:
Configuring {integration_title} using YAML is being removed.

Your existing YAML configuration has been imported into the UI automatically.

Remove the `{domain}` platform configuration from the `sensor` section of your configuration.yaml file and restart Home Assistant to fix this issue. The `device_tracker` YAML platform keeps working and has its own migration repair.
deprecated_yaml.title: The {integration_title} YAML configuration is being removed

migrate_device_tracker.description:
Configuring {integration_title} device tracking with YAML is being removed in Home Assistant 2027.5.

The legacy YAML scanner keeps working until then, but it is no longer imported automatically: while the YAML platform is configured, the trackers in known_devices.yaml keep their entity ids, so replacement trackers are only created after the migration, which keeps the original entity ids.

To migrate manually: remove the `{domain}` platform from the `device_tracker` section of configuration.yaml, remove its entries from known_devices.yaml, and restart Home Assistant. Then remove the existing {integration_title} entry, set up the integration through the UI and enable the device trackers you want to keep.
migrate_device_tracker.title: The {integration_title} device tracker YAML configuration is being removed
